found_values.value: The TPS55285 takes current back into its output and passes it to its input in FPWM only: 'The high-side N-MOSFET is not turned off even if the current through the MOSFET is zero. In PFM, the default (MODE register 06h bit 1 = 0), it turns the switches off at zero current 'to prevent the reverse current from output to input' (6.4.2), so a returned current raises the rail.
